bounds: evidence/hw-h1-3-bounds.json (committed c09ad45 before any code or run; unchanged)

runs.adapter: D3D12 WARP (mesh shader tier 1), debug layer on
runs.result: fail on one control, everything else met. Identity: the triangle-index and depth targets are bit-equal between the mesh and vertex pipelines on all six views (terrain and hall, wide, close, grazing; 533,531 to 1,425,792 covered pixels). Culling is exercised: the close cameras keep 752 of 1,600 and 171 of 352 meshlets. The flipped-cone control differs on five views (106,177 to 1,425,792 pixels) and on 0 pixels in hall close, so it does not discriminate there and the bound 'pixels differ on every scene and camera' is missed.
runs.cause_inferred: In hall close the visible geometry is column sides, whose meshlets span normals over more than 90 degrees and carry no cone, so neither cone test can drop them; the floor and walls in view face away from that camera and are back-face culled by both pipelines. This also shows that the hall scene's floor and walls are wound inconsistently for single-sided rendering. Inferred from the scene construction, not measured meshlet by meshlet.

runs.result: identity bit-equal (ids and depth) on all six views; culling exercised; the cone control again changes 0 pixels in hall close (the recorded miss). Mesh over vertex speedups (500 measured draws): terrain close 1.59 [1.55, 1.61], hall close 1.31 [1.31, 1.40]; slower on the wide and grazing views, 0.69 to 0.84 with intervals below 1. hw-h1-3-d3d12-rtx4090.json

Timing note (2026-10-10, after the reruns): the first RTX window (19:47 to 19:53Z) was disturbed by GPU use outside the lock protocol (inferred: the H1.2 shared scan's own distribution turned bimodal mid-run, p95 9.3 ms against a 0.28 ms median, while no lock holder overlapped). Its timings are kept and marked unreliable; they are not used for any statement. Identity bit-equal in every run; the hall-close control miss repeats. Speedups are NOT stable between runs although tight within each: terrain wide 0.71, 1.36, 0.70; terrain grazing 0.69, 1.00, 0.81; hall wide 0.69, 1.04, 0.84; hall grazing 0.84, 0.96, 0.88. Stable in all three runs: the mesh path is faster on the close views where culling drops about half the meshlets, terrain close 1.59, 2.47, 1.52 and hall close 1.31, 1.67, 1.33. The draws take 20 to 180 microseconds with unlocked clocks (snapshots show the SM clock between 2,775 and 870 MHz), so between-run variance dominates.

timing_note: WARP timings are in hw-h1-3-d3d12-warp.json and are not a claim.
not_done: No bound changed. A control that discriminates on every view would be a new, dated addition, not a replacement.
